Tiago did an excellent job at my house. Even after three floods, the tile still looks perfect and the grout lines are flawless. He uses high-quality materials, doesn't waste tile, and pays great attention to detail. He installed my bathroom, tubs, and showers beautifully. Hard-working and professional, highly recommended!

Top Notch from beginning to end! We just had our bedroom carpets replaced with Tile floors and our experience with Tiago was excellent. He was great to work with and the installation was amazing! By the way, he was very respectful of our home and kept a neat work space. Don't hesitate to use Tiago!
